description: Revise a draft's substance against critique findings or a brief — structural and argumentative changes with a change log, meaning changed deliberately. Use when the user wants restructuring, a different argument or arc, scenes rewritten, sections cut or added, or fixes applied from writing-critique findings. Line-only polish is writing-edit; read-only diagnosis is writing-critique.
